activities.name: raw_process_movement
activities.description:
This notebook will leverage the Healthcare Data Solutions library to move/extract (extract ZIP files and move) files for multiple HDS modalities, which contain various namespaces and file extensions. This framework will move/extract (extract ZIP files and move) files based on the 'file_orchestration_config' configuration, which contains mapping details such as modality, modality_format, extension etc.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: ai_enrichment_bronze_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity facilitates the ingestion of enrichment json and ndjson data into Delta tables within the bronze lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.

activities.name: ai_enrichment_silver_ingestion
activities.description:
This notebook activity transforms the enrichment data from the bronze lakehouse and ingests it into the silver lakehouse.
Please note that there should not be more than one instance of this notebook running as this will cause inconsistent results.
